payload.title: Night Relay: The Last Lantern Post
payload.one_line_pitch: Help a festival visitor reach the last lantern: combine a route guide and tonight's notice, then send directions with a reason they can trust.
payload.target_player: Proposal awaiting owner approval: Grade 4, approximately ages 9-10, in a short classroom or home session. Two short texts and structured choices may suit supported informational reading; text complexity, age fit and independent-reading demands are unverified.
payload.target_subject: Proposed ELA: interpret and combine informational sources to communicate an actionable plan with a source-supported explanation. Spelling, typing speed and arithmetic are not measured.
payload.target_players_and_mode: Proposed solo browser session with one authored simulated recipient; no online play or pass-and-play.
payload.core_loop: Read the visitor request and two sources; choose a path and entrance; compose directions and a because-explanation using one relevant detail from each source; send; inspect the recipient interpretation and source check; revise and resend or replay.
design_pillars: Each source matters: the map connects paths to gates; the notice identifies tonight's visitor entrance.
Explain the plan: directions and a because-clause connect a relevant detail from each source.
Repair with evidence: the recipient reflects the message; targeted source links support untimed revision.
payload.learning_goal: Given a visitor request, written route guide with equivalent map, and separate festival notice, infer which step-free path reaches the visitor entrance and communicate the path, gate and reason using relevant details from both sources.
player_decisions: Which path reaches the gate admitting visitors tonight?
Which map and notice details support the plan, and what conclusion connects them?
payload.repeatable_feedback_and_recovery: Distinguish complete, incomplete, wrong-entrance, contradictory and unsupported messages using the slice response cases. Preserve the draft and link relevant sources. An omitted explanation is not a fictional navigation failure.
payload.smallest_complete_vertical_slice: One visitor, two step-free paths to different gates, one route guide/map, one notice, one route-and-entrance decision with an evidence-linked explanation, authored feedback, revision and replay. Detailed content and acceptance requirements are in the VerticalSliceBrief.

portfolio_differentiation.portfolio_claim: Catalog describes following clues, solving math and cracking a case.
portfolio_differentiation.source_file: games-site/src/data/games.ts: entry math-detective, description and controls
portfolio_differentiation.difference: Shares inspect-and-choose interaction. Proposed distinction is communicating a plan to a recipient and repairing its explanation using written sources.

portfolio_differentiation.portfolio_claim: Catalog describes controlled cart-and-track experiments, changing one variable, measuring and comparing trials to support claims.
portfolio_differentiation.difference: Shares evidence-supported reasoning. This proposal interprets fixed authored information for another person rather than generating experimental evidence.

portfolio_differentiation.portfolio_claim: Catalog describes inspecting atmospheric evidence, forecasting and comparison with a simulated weather system.
portfolio_differentiation.difference: Shares decision and feedback structure. This proposal evaluates support and clarity of a directions message rather than forecast agreement.

portfolio_differentiation.portfolio_claim: Catalog describes measuring worlds, keeping evidence, comparing results and supporting a claim.
portfolio_differentiation.difference: Evidence-and-claim loops already exist in the catalog. The proposed differentiator is audience-aware communication and clarification; no portfolio-wide uniqueness claim is made.

curriculum_alignment.alignment: Proposed partial alignment: support a route explanation with accurate, relevant source details.
curriculum_alignment.direct_mechanic: Require the South Path-to-Bell Gate detail M2, the Bell Gate visitor-entry detail N1, and conclusion C1 connecting them. Choosing the correct route alone does not complete the task.
curriculum_alignment.status: proposal; owner and educator review pending; no learner evidence

curriculum_alignment.alignment: Proposed partial alignment: combine two informational texts about visiting the lantern post into an actionable message.
curriculum_alignment.direct_mechanic: A written route guide with equivalent map supplies path connections; a separate notice supplies admission rules. The player composes a plan and reason using both. Structured choices offer limited composition evidence, not independent writing mastery.
curriculum_alignment.status: proposal; educator must confirm source adequacy and scaffolding; no learner evidence

accessibility_approach: Require keyboard and assistive-technology access to the entire loop, equivalent route information, visible non-color states, readable resizing, persistent untimed feedback and recoverable focus. Concrete criteria are in the VerticalSliceBrief; none are claimed tested.

in_scope: one route guide with equivalent map plus one notice
one route-and-entrance choice and structured supported explanation
authored recipient interpretation, source check, revision and replay
out_of_scope: free-text grading or generated recipient dialogue
final implementation plan in this revision

success_signals: Proposed observation: distinguish viable route selection from relevant source selection and a valid connection between the details.
Separate first attempt, prompted revision and same-scenario replay. No spelling, typing-speed or response-time score; no mastery or transfer inference.
payload.main_risk: Structured choices may permit guessing and answer memorization. Require a connected explanation and distinguish first attempts from assisted repair. Source necessity is a design property, not evidence of learning.

unresolved_owner_decisions.recommended_default: Grade 4, approximately ages 9-10, in a short solo classroom or home browser session with optional adult support.
unresolved_owner_decisions.consequence: Use two short sources and structured sentences; educator review and intended-age observation must establish reading load and age fit.

unresolved_owner_decisions.recommended_default: ELA informational reading with proposed partial RI.4.1 and RI.4.9 mapping, subject to jurisdiction confirmation.
unresolved_owner_decisions.consequence: Assess source-supported explanation and integration only; no claim of coverage, mastery, writing proficiency or learning effectiveness.

unresolved_owner_decisions.recommended_default: Keep Night Relay: The Last Lantern Post, a calm fictional festival and an explicit step-free need; both routes are step-free.
unresolved_owner_decisions.consequence: Difficulty comes from route/entrance integration. Educator and disabled-player review must assess clarity and respectful portrayal before content acceptance.

unresolved_owner_decisions.recommended_default: One solo route-and-entrance decision communicated with a supported explanation; fixed authored feedback and unlimited untimed revision.
unresolved_owner_decisions.consequence: Exclude free-text grading, generated dialogue, arithmetic, speed scoring, multiplayer and progression. Same-scenario replay cannot establish transfer.

unresolved_owner_decisions.decision: Acceptance owner, target and completion contract
unresolved_owner_decisions.recommended_default: Owner names the product acceptance owner; browser delivery with a full offline session after initial load. Proposed support matrix: Windows Edge/Chrome with keyboard and NVDA, plus iPad Safari/VoiceOver.
unresolved_owner_decisions.consequence: Exact supported versions, device availability and completion contract must be agreed before implementation acceptance. No engine choice, technical architecture or release authorization is implied.

unresolved_owner_decisions.recommended_default: Keep educator/content review, intended-age observation, independent accessibility review with disabled-player feedback, and owner product acceptance separate; release remains a later owner decision.
unresolved_owner_decisions.consequence: Use this proposal for a separate planning discussion with assumptions visible. Neither schema validity nor this revision supplies human approval.
